name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
summary: In Thousand Needles, Wizlo Bearingshiner waits at Whitereach Post after a centaur ambush. He needs his invention back from the wreckage, where a caged panther wears it around its neck.

sections.title: Ambush in the Needles
sections.body: Beneath Thousand Needles' sandstone spires, centaur guard the canyon floor. Just north of Whitereach Post, they overran a trade caravan, killed its travelers and plundered the wagons. Only Wizlo Bearingshiner, a goblin tinkerer, escaped. He limped back to safety.

sections.title: An Unlikely Guardian
sections.body: The centaur left one ruined wagon untouched, though they looted nearly every other valuable scrap. Inside its transport cage, a ferocious, enraged panther remains bound with Wizlo's prized hypercapacitor gizmo fastened around its neck. The centaur feared the beast and left the cage closed. Now Wizlo entrusts its key to mercenaries willing to face the predator and reclaim his invention.

sections.title: Tinkerer's Ambition
sections.body: Wizlo Bearingshiner calls the hypercapacitor gizmo his finest creation, though he cannot yet say what it does. Even after lives are risked to recover it from a caged predator, he admits he still needs to tinker with the device to understand its purpose.

faq.answer: Wizlo Bearingshiner is a goblin tinkerer and merchant who took refuge at Whitereach Post after centaur ambushed and destroyed his caravan on Thousand Needles' canyon floor.

faq.q: Why is the gizmo around the panther's neck?
aliases: why does the panther have the gizmo
faq.answer: The gizmo ended up fastened around the captive panther's neck during its transport or the centaur ambush. The centaur feared the beast and left the cage untouched, making the panther the device's guardian.

faq.q: Where is the wrecked caravan located?
faq.answer: The wrecked caravan lies just north of Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles, among shattered wagons and hostile centaur camps.

faq.q: Why didn't the centaur loot the cage?
faq.answer: Wizlo says the enraged panther was so ferocious that even the ruthless centaur marauders feared it. They left it locked in its cage rather than risk opening it.

faq.q: What does the Hypercapacitor Gizmo actually do?
faq.answer: Wizlo calls the Hypercapacitor Gizmo his finest invention, but after its return he admits he still needs to study and tinker with it to discover what it does.
Whitereach Post is a tauren settlement allied with the Horde. Set among the canyon mesas, it watches centaur activity and shelters Horde travelers.

angles.text: Wizlo's frantic pursuit of an invention whose purpose he cannot quite recall shows the chaotic, trial-and-error ways of goblin engineering.
From Whitereach Post, Horde scouts and travelers battle the predatory centaur clans that menace routes through central Kalimdor.
The enraged panther in the wrecked caravan is a formidable beast, fierce enough to terrify a full warband of centaur marauders.
